name: Dunk
source: Ample Market landing page (curated by Mobbin), reference supplied 19 Aug 2026. Structure and rhythm extracted; colour re-pitched onto Dunk's purple. Not a copy of any asset.

grammar.rhythm: Full-bleed bands alternating light ground and deep purple. Every band is one idea.
grammar.headings: Centred, constrained to ~18ch, eyebrow pill above.
grammar.cta: Email field + solid button inline, repeated at hero and close. Micro-proof line underneath.
grammar.cards: Generous radius, flat fill, no shadow. Results grid uses a pastel set so figures read as distinct.
grammar.accents: Hand-drawn marker doodles as counterweight. Two per page, never more.

display.note: Nearest Google face to the reference's geometric grotesque.

data.note: Labels and figures. SEO is a measurement pitch — the numbers should read as instrument output.

color.note: Coral against deep purple is the deliberate non-obvious pairing — purple with violet-blue is the generic AI default and is avoided.
